how_to_use: Front picks a scenario key, resolves satellite_preset against lote-sentinel-presets.json and weeds against photo-point-presets.json, then computes the score with the scoring block below. expected_score is a self-check, not an input. All photos[].file paths are relative to data/ (e.g. presets/fotos/limpio_1.jpg means data/presets/fotos/limpio_1.jpg).

scoring.score_bp_note: HALF-UP rounding, not banker's rounding: Python's round() rounds .5 ties to even, JS's Math.round() always rounds .5 up. floor(x + 0.5) matches Math.round for these positive scores, so both languages produce the same integer from the same float.
scoring.precision_warning: Margins are 1.5 to 4.4 points. Use the published 3-decimal ndvi as-is. Do NOT round any input before scoring.

bueno.label: Campaña OK - vigor alto, malezas bajas
bueno.narrative_note: El NDVI apenas cambia entre 'bueno' y 'malo' (0.782 -> 0.763) porque la vegetación es inercial en 5 días. Este escenario de referencia está en verde por lluvia alta (46.7 mm/7d) y malezas simuladas bajas (12%); el satélite solo no alcanza para explicar el semáforo.

mixto.label: NDVI bueno pero malezas medias - muestra el valor de las fotos
mixto.satellite_reuse_note: Reuses fecha_buena's satellite block on purpose. Only the SIMULATED weeds differ. There is no third satellite date.
mixto.narrative_note: El satélite del 2 feb es el mismo que en 'bueno' (NDVI 0.782, lluvia 46.7 mm): no cambia nada. Lo único que mueve el semáforo a amarillo son las malezas SIMULADAS al 55%, visibles en las fotos y no en el satélite.

malo.label: Misma campaña - seca + malezas
malo.narrative_note: 5 días después de 'bueno', el NDVI casi no bajó (0.782 -> 0.763): la vegetación es inercial y el satélite solo no muestra daño. La caída de verde a rojo la explican la lluvia (46.7 -> 0.1 mm) y las malezas SIMULADAS (12% -> 65%).

photo_honesty_note: All preset photos are Unsplash stock images of generic fields. They are NOT photographs of this lot. See presets/fotos/ATTRIBUTION.md.
photos_ownership_note: data/presets/fotos/* are provided by another track (Vision/photo owner), not generated by this pack; this file only defines the contract (paths + point_id mapping).

photos: presets/fotos/* (owned by another track, not generated by this pack)
